lines.en: I’m not sure why she smirks at me when we both know she isn’t actually going to make me do anything. That’s just not the type of person she is.
And that’s likely part of why she’s cemented herself as such a subtly pivotal figure in this endlessly confused half-life of mine.
I’m sure I’m not the only one around here who’s “confused,” though. And I need to stop putting myself into a bubble that prevents me from actually caring about that.
Touka Tsukioka is a girl. Not a woman. Not a mother. She’s a girl. Plain and simple.

But this causes complications for me because it turns her into something I don’t want her to be. And accepting that truth brings me closer to making one more mistake and losing one more piece of myself.
Maybe it’d be okay if she gave me a piece of her as well, though.
I’ve told myself I shouldn’t care. That I’d given up on finding happiness and that I’d settle for reverting to the real me — a man who fucks those he shouldn’t and forgets those he should.
So what am I doing pretending roles like “matriarch” even matter to me at this point?
What am I doing not trying to fuck her when she fits the criteria of everyone else I’ve corrupted almost perfectly?
Am I just fooling myself? Because my body most certainly wants her. It’s only my mind that doesn’t.
But I’ve never trusted that part of myself before. And I definitely don’t think I should start doing that now that it’s clearly gotten worse..
Is all of this just a clever way of convincing my brain to dwell less on the past and more on the future since I know at least that will never leave me behind?
Or is she closer to resembling something even more forbidden than the youngest fruit that fell from the same tree?
Whatever she is, it scares me...because it makes me doubt myself. And that scares me even more because my first instinct is to wrap myself up in her to find comfort.
It’s an endless cycle of fear and love, spearheaded by a girl who doesn’t even know the power she wields.
Or maybe she does and she’s just like me — denying it because it’s complicated and conflicts with what her heart craves.
We wind up back at the manor somehow. I don’t know. I spent so much time trying to argue away my erection that I must have blurred out everything that happened after lunch.
I’m sure it went well. And I’m sure Touka enjoyed herself if she was willing to take me back home after it all played out.
But I also know that this is typically the part of a “date” where one invites the other up for tea or coffee before clothes start to come off and poor decisions start to be made.
It’s the perfect moment to figure out whether she really is important to me in a way that separates her from the rest.
But I don’t like “perfect” moments.
So I hope that she ruins it.
: Is something the matter, Sensei? You’ve been rather quiet since we entered the manor.
: Yeah well, one wrong move here and someone could slit my throat.
: I doubt anyone would do that while I’m in such close proximity to you. Dirtying my clothes would be greatly frowned upon.
: Then be sure to stay close so I can make it home after this.
: And to which home will you be returning today? The one with your niece who is in love with you? Or the one with your girlfriend who is in love with you?
: Or one of your girlfriends, I suppose. I’m not quite sure how many you have, come to think of it. But I do know that it’s more than I’d personally recommend.
: And I’m sure you’d recommend only one, correct? You don’t strike me as a polyamorist.
: One would be ideal, yes. But it isn’t uncommon for those in my echelon to take a mistress as well.
: Of course, that only goes for the men. Us women aren’t typically awarded the same level of freedom. Which isn’t to say I’d do such a thing anyway. I just figured I’d share.
: Thanks for the info. But you’re a girl, not a woman.
: Some might disagree, Sensei. You’ve noted on many occasions just how much more mature I am than the rest of the girls in our class, have you not?
: Are you trying to tell me something right now, Touka?
: Is there something you’d like me to tell you?
: No, actually.
: No?
: Right. It’s already wrong of me to have followed you all the way to what I can only imagine is one of thirty bedrooms you have.
: Yet here you are. And here I want you to be.
: Touka-
: Would you perhaps like to see a tour of-
: Oh my! If it isn’t my eldest daughter and her “former” teacher.
: Aaaand of course my mother is here.
: How unexpected. I’d known the two of you ran off somewhere, but if I had any idea that you’d be returning together, I’d have had dinner prepared for you.
: We already ate. But thank you, Mother. And thank you for keeping tabs on my every move as well. It’s good to know that I am always being watched.
: Or perhaps your teacher is the one I’m keeping tabs on and you just happened to be there with him?
: Yeah, I wouldn’t put that past you.
: Hahah! Hilarious as ever! Oh, how I enjoy that blunt sense of humor of yours.
: Ahem.
: What’s wrong, dear? You’re not coming down with a cold, are you?
: No, Mother...I was just in the middle of a conversation.
: Oh, good! Then surely you won’t mind if I join you for a few minutes.
: But-
: Don’t worry, darling. I was just on my way to the sauna, so you aren’t interrupting anything.
: That’s...not what I was trying to imply...
: Oh? Am I perhaps...interrupting something?
: It is rather late to be receiving lessons, isn’t it? Let alone lessons from a former teacher. Unless something has changed, of course.
: Hah...I was just giving Sensei a tour of the central pavilion. I can assure you it was nothing out of the ordinary.
: Nonsense. What are your intentions with my daughter?
: Mother!
: Hahah! Oh, I’ve always wanted to say that. I’m so funny.
: The funniest, truly...
: Intimidating as ever too.
: What reason is there to be intimidated? You’ve already made it quite clear to me that you have no such intentions with Touka. What with seeing her more as a “mother figure” and all. Correct?
: I’m sorry?
: Hah...
: You must be misunderstanding something, Mother. We’ve had a legitimate competition in regard to that topic, and I lost.
: Besides, I’m merely half of Sensei’s age. He wouldn’t possibly view me in such a way. Right, Sensei?
: Why do you do this?
: Do what? All I did was repeat what you told me.
: Yeah, but did you have to do it right in front of her?
: ...What?
: Would it be better for her to not know your intentions, Sensei? Because the last thing I want is my beloved daughter being “led on.” I believe that phrase is applicable here, correct?
: I’m not “leading her on” because I see her in a different light from the other girls her age. I just-
: So that’s how it really is then.
: Touka-
: Good night, Sensei. I apologize for misinterpreting just what sort of relationship we had.
: I will see you in the morning, Mother.
: Goodnight, dear.
: Why?
: Whatever do you mean, Akira?
: You knew she wouldn’t want to hear something like that. So why would you put both of us on the spot and just air it out like it was nothing? She was having a great day. She was in a good mood.
: Apologies, but would it have been better for her to throw herself at you only to have you reject her? Because I’d imagine the emotional trauma that would cause would be significantly worse.
: And I was under the impression that is what was about to happen.
: So, from my point of view, it’s like I rescued both of you from a terrible misunderstanding! You should be thanking me.
: Not everything has to involve you, Tsubasa.
: This isn’t “everything,” Akira. This is my daughter we’re talking about.
: Yeah, but you know you’d be doing the same thing even if it wasn’t.
: Probably! But that’s not what’s happening this time, so it doesn’t apply.
: Stop interfering.
: Will there be consequences if I don’t?
: Probably not. But stop anyway.
: Shame. I like consequences.
: I’m surprised you know that when you’ve likely never experienced any.
: We can’t all be as experienced as you, Akira. Which is why it’s your job to teach people like us.
: I don’t think there’s anything I can teach you that you don’t already know, Tsubasa.
: Oh, darling. We both know that’s not true.
: Tell me — has Touka shown you where to find our massage parlor yet?
: What?
: AAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHH!
: On second thought, maybe that’s a secret that would be best kept until next time.
: Right now, you have a job to do.
: Yeah, what else is new?
: Tons, I’m sure! But I’m just an uninvolved passerby who doesn’t know any of it.
: And I’m the king of France.
: Oooh! Enchanté~
Tsubasa holds her hand out to me, but I ignore it before she has the chance to pull it away.
But when I walk into Touka’s room to clear up the not-so-misunderstood misunderstanding, I quickly forget why I even opened the door in the first place.
: Okay. Now this is just unnecessary.
: Go away. I’m brooding.
: Why are you brooding, Touka?
: Because you made me look like a fool in front of my mother! And you made me feel like a fool in front of me!
: You can’t be in front of yourself. That’s not a thing.
: Shut up! And leave me alone!
: Do you want to talk or not?
: No! Go away!
: Okay, well we’re going to talk anyway.
: Guards!
: Please don’t call the guards on me. Someone needs to take care of Ami.
: Well maybe I can do it since I’m basically her grandmother now!
: I’m coming over there. You have approximately ten minutes to prepare yourself before I make it.
: Stay away! I don’t want to see you right now!
I obviously don’t stay away because I do want to make this right. I’m just not really sure if I’ll be able to since I’m still sort of figuring out what I want Touka to be.
Because yes, she’s like a mother figure to me.
But I’ve given you enough hints about how little something like that matters.
I want it to. Don’t get me wrong.
But some things are just beyond fixing and I often feel like I’m one of them.
Anyway, Touka recoils and crawls away the second I make it to her bed.
Just kidding. She immediately leaps forward, knocking me over and crawling on top of me.
: A mother?! Really?!
: I understand that I’m nurturing and comforting and that you’re a misguided pervert who has likely never experienced maternal love, but come on! Seriously?! I’m just a girl! You said it yourself!
: It’s complicated, okay? I don’t really get it either.
: Well, figure it out because that’s not a way I want to be seen!
: I’m happy to comfort you when you need it! And I understand that you need it rather frequently because you’re a misguided pervert who has likely never experienced maternal love-
: Did you really need to say that a second time?
: But that’s just not the way I see us, Sensei!
: Then how do you see us, Touka?
: That’s not something I can say now that I know you’re picturing me as your parent!
: That’s not the only way I picture you. And even if it was, it wouldn’t change anything about where this relationship can go.
: That is a very disturbing thing to say!
: Yeah. This might come as a surprise to you, but I’m pretty fucked up in a lot of very unfortunate ways.
: Hah...I seriously can’t believe you just let me get carried away and...flirt with you despite the way you’ve been seeing me this whole time. I called it a “date” and everything.
: When did this start? Because on the beach-
: It was around Halloween, I think.
: I was feeling lost and scared and you were just...the one I looked for. And it didn’t really dawn on me why until I really started thinking about it.
: Do you know how I interpreted that, Sensei?
: I have my guesses.
: I thought you liked me. I thought you really did see me differently than everyone else.
: I do.
: But not in the right way!
: I want you to see me as a woman.
: The kind that’s not related to you.
: So-
: I like you.
: And maybe this is inappropriate for me to say as your student, but that’s not stopping anyone else and it just isn’t fair if I’m the only one keeping it to myself at this point.
: If that disgusts you, fine. But it’s something you needed to know.
: It doesn’t disgust me at all.
: But you see me as a mother.
: Yeah, but I’ve also been staring at your chest all day.
: You’re probably just hungry.
: I’ve also had an erection since the moment we met up pretty much.
: You know, I had a feeling that’s what was poking me but it felt wrong to point it out.
: Doesn’t all of this just show that you’re not only like a matriarch, though? Like, there’s very clearly some desire at play here.
: But will it ever go anywhere? Or will you condemn me to the role of the one who comforts you upon your return home from someone else?
: Because I can only tell you everything will be okay so many times. I can only give you so many lap pillows and so many head rubs.
: You can leave out the head rubs. Not really my thing.
: There needs to be something for me. Do you understand what I’m saying?
: I’m happy to give, but not without something in return.
: And what I want in return is far more intimate than a lap pillow.
: Do you understand what I’m saying?
: Do I really need to say it?
: Yes.
: The thing that’s poking you isn’t giving it away?
: I need to hear you say you understand.
She doesn’t blink.
She doesn’t move.
She stays perfectly still like one of the many monuments in the room and, in every single way, she’s more beautiful than all of them.
To think this creature on top of me, who rivals the output of artisan hands without any effort at all, would want me is perplexing.
She’s not a random girl in a random high school class. She’s a young woman who could have anyone she wants. And still it’s me.
I don’t get it.
I’ll never get it.
: I understand.
But I tell her I do because that’s what I’m good for — filling holes in hearts and bodies while ignoring the gaps in myself.
: Will you condemn me, Sensei?
: Or will you make me grovel?
: Would you actually grovel for me?
: If it works, maybe. I’ve never tried before.
: You like me that much, huh?
: I have very poor taste in men, apparently.
: You really do.
: But no...
: I won’t condemn you.
: I can’t change the way I see you.
: But I also can’t deny the fact that I want to fuck your brains out.
: Oh my.
: That was...forward.
: Yeah, well...you asked.
: I did, didn’t I?...
: I also...
: Would like for you to do that...
: N-Not right now, though! Eventually!
: This is all...happening really fast and...

: I will admit that I’m still rather turned off by the fact that you’d do such a thing with someone you’re openly admitting to viewing as a mother figure. Even if the figure in question is a teenage girl.
: Yeah. I can’t say I really blame you for that.
: So...what do we do now? Mother is bound to ask what transpired in here when I see her in the morning.
: If you really want to fuck with her, just tell her we had sex.
: Sensei! I couldn’t possibly-
: Stop.
: Call me Akira from now on.
Touka and I decided it would be best to keep our conversation confidential from Tsubasa, but I can only guess how well that will work.
I’m sure she’ll find out sooner or later.
And I’m sure she’ll just try to get herself involved again once she does.
So yeah, that could be really problematic given the nature of our relationship and what the future holds.
But I’m trying to think of the positives.
And the positives in this case sound very exciting.
: Come to bed, Aki-kun.
Touka’s affection has increased to [touka_love]!
